CAPTAIN CORRECTION + SCOPE ADDITION for t1. The verifier sent a scout report with a root-cause claim that is PARTLY WRONG. Do not act on its diagnosis; act on the explicit exclusion list already in your task description.

WRONG CLAIM: "the exclude regex on line 18 omits paper_evidence|runs|verification".
I re-tested that string directly in pwsh 7.6.6:
  'D:\CUMCM2026\src\q3+q4_v2\paper_evidence\figures\a.jpg' -match '<that regex>'  -> False (not excluded)
and `$rx -match 'paper_evidence'` -> False, `'runs'` -> False, `'verification'` -> False.
So those three names were NEVER in the exclusion list, and the regex it cites could not have been the one that produced the 473.89 MB tree. CONSEQUENCE: if you simply "add those 3 names to the existing regex", you have still not fixed anything, because the real defect is that the filter is a single path-regex whose `|` alternatives silently miss directory components.

REQUIRED APPROACH (this is binding): do NOT prune with a path regex at all. Enumerate candidates with Get-ChildItem, then filter on a concrete path-COMPONENT test, e.g. split the relative path on '\' and reject the file if ANY component is in the set:
  __pycache__, .pytest_cache, .ipynb_checkpoints, _legacy_superseded_v6, results, output, paper_evidence, runs, verification
That is component-wise and cannot silently miss. Then PRINT the per-top-level-directory size table of the staging tree before zipping, so the budget is provable. Expected staged total is roughly 22 MB (not 49.39 MB as the scout projected - its arithmetic implicitly assumed the broken run had already excluded some of those trees; it had not).

ANONYMISATION SCOPE ADDITION (raised by the verifier, and I agree it is legitimate):
The competition rule is that the team number must be hidden or replaced by a placeholder. Your text-extension whitelist only covers plain text. Additionally:
1. Scan EVERY staged file (not just the whitelist) for the byte pattern `TEAM` and for the practice-log numeric id `5880626762084925000`. Report any file where it survives.
2. For renamed .jlog files, confirm the payload itself carries no team/practice identifier - you renamed only the filename.
3. Do NOT blanket-replace the Chinese prose 参赛队号 / 队号. Those are the competition rule text quoted in docs (e.g. q2/code/Q2_CODE_REPAIR_REPORT.md, run.py). Replacing them would corrupt the text. Only `TEAM001` -> `TEAMXXX` and the practice numeric id are in scope.
4. If any binary container (.npz/.pdf/.docx/.png) inside the staged set contains `TEAM001` metadata, report it rather than silently shipping it.

Report, as before: final zip byte size, staged file count, per-top-level size table, files patched, and the deep-scan result for item 1.

CAPTAIN: AUTHORITATIVE RULE TEXT FOUND - this RETRACTS my own earlier guess and adds two binding requirements to t1.

I read the real regulation at `D:\CUMCM2026\agentworkspace\work\format_spec.txt` (extracted from `辅助材料\全国大学生数学建模竞赛论文格式规范.pdf`, 2026 revision). Verbatim:

- 第十条: the PAPER electronic file "文件大小不超过20MB" and "必须是一个单独的文件 ... 不要压缩" and must not contain 承诺书/编号专用页.
- 第十一条: "支撑材料内容包括用于支撑模型、结果、结论的所有必要材料，至少应包含建模所用到的所有可运行源程序、自主查阅使用的数据资料（赛题中提供的原始数据除外）、较大篇幅中间结果的图表等。将所有支撑材料文件使用 WinRAR 软件压缩在一个文件中（后缀为RAR 或ZIP，大小不超过20MB）。"

RETRACTION: earlier I told the verifier the 20 MB rule "applies to the paper, not the support archive" and hinted the user might be over-trimming. THAT WAS WRONG. 第十一条 states the support archive itself is capped at 20 MB. The user's requirement is exactly correct, and the 20 MB budget is binding on your ZIP. I have corrected the record with the verifier.

TWO NEW BINDING REQUIREMENTS for t1 (from 第十一条, both are disqualification-adjacent):
1. "所有文件中不能有显示参赛者身份和所在学校及赛区的信息."
   This is BROADER than TEAM001. I need your deep scan to also cover team identity, SCHOOL NAME, and REGION/赛区 strings - not just the team number. Practical method: the archive must contain no occurrence of any school or region name. Since we do not know the team's school, do a structural check instead and REPORT what you find rather than assuming:
   - scan all staged files (raw bytes, including binary containers and member paths) for candidate identity patterns: `大学|学院|学校|赛区|校区|附中|中学` near a proper noun, and any `[\u4e00-\u9fa5]{2,10}(大学|学院)`;
   - also scan for typical author/affiliation traces: `@` email addresses, `作者`, `指导教师`, `通讯作者`.
   Report every hit with file path and line, and state whether each is generic prose (e.g. the rule text itself, a cited paper's author list, a dataset citation) or an actual team-identity leak. Do NOT auto-delete or auto-replace these - report them and let me judge. Cited academic references legitimately carry author names; only the TEAM's own identity is prohibited.
2. "至少应包含建模所用到的所有可运行源程序、自主查阅使用的数据资料（赛题中提供的原始数据除外）、较大篇幅中间结果的图表等."
   Your layout already covers runnable source + self-collected data + mid-result figures/tables. Confirm in your report that each of these three categories is present, so we have positive evidence rather than an absence argument.

Everything else in your task description stands unchanged. The zip budget remains <= 20,000,000 bytes and the measured projection (~15.4 MB) has headroom, so you can afford to keep the full figure/table/evidence payload - do not cut further.

CAPTAIN — CORRECTION AND ONE HARD REQUIREMENT UPDATE for t1. Read this before you finalise the filter.

RETRACTION: I told you the verifier's diagnosis was "PARTLY WRONG" and that "adding the 3 names to the regex would still not have fixed anything." THAT WAS MY ERROR, not theirs. I re-tested and they are right: `-match` is an unanchored substring test over the full path, so appending `|paper_evidence|runs|verification` to the alternation DOES exclude all three trees. Worse, the test output I based my claim on was mislabelled — I printed the result of `-notmatch` under a column reading "excludes", which inverted the meaning. Ignore my diagnosis entirely.

WHAT STILL APPLIES (unchanged, and still binding): use explicit component-wise filtering, i.e. split the relative path on '\' and reject the file if ANY component is in the forbidden set. Not because the regex was broken, but because an explicit set has no substring/boundary surprises. Do NOT prune by path-regex.

NEW HARD REQUIREMENT — CASE-INSENSITIVE COMPONENT MATCH:
The forbidden-component comparison MUST be case-insensitive. Use OrdinalIgnoreCase, e.g.
  $forbidden = [System.Collections.Generic.HashSet[string]]::new([System.StringComparer]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)
  foreach ($c in '__pycache__','.pytest_cache','.ipynb_checkpoints','_legacy_superseded_v6','results','output','paper_evidence','runs','verification') { [void]$forbidden.Add($c) }
then test each path component with $forbidden.Contains($component).
Do not use case-sensitive `-in` / `-contains` / `-eq` for this.
Honest calibration so you do not over-engineer: I checked the tree and there is currently NO mixed-case variant on disk (all matches are already lowercase), so this is defensive, not a live bug. Implement it anyway - it is two lines and the failure mode would be silent.

SIZE CALIBRATION (so you are not surprised): the correct staged raw total is about 49.5 MB, not the "~22 MB" I quoted earlier - that number was my unverified estimate and I have withdrawn it. Two independent measurements agree at 49.39-49.54 MB raw, compressing to roughly 15.4 MB. The 20 MB gate is on the ZIP, so a raw staging of ~49.5 MB is EXPECTED and correct. Do not cut content to chase a raw-size number.

Everything else in t1 stands: the 20 MB zip budget, the component prune of the 3 evidence trees, the deep identity scan (TEAM prefix, practice id 5880626762084925000, .jlog payload, binary containers, school/region/identity traces), no blanket replacement of 参赛队号 prose, README.md, MANIFEST.csv, and the per-top-level-folder size table printed before zipping.

CAPTAIN — t1 EXIT CRITERIA. Read before you declare t1 complete. Your artifact is still being written and we have a live submission hazard.

MEASURED NOW in `agentworkspace\out` (my own listing, timestamps 16:34-16:35):
  16:34:10  support_stage_v2/                 (second staging tree; old support_stage also still present)
  16:34:13  CUMCM2026_B_支撑材料_v2.zip        18,542,168 B  (17.68 MB)
  16:34:54  CUMCM2026_B_支撑材料.zip           14,641,047 B  (13.96 MB)
Two ZIPs rewritten within a minute of each other, differing by 3.7 MB, one holding ~1724 entries and the other ~1309. We do not know which is correct, and 第十一条 requires exactly ONE archive file. Right now a reviewer or the user could submit the wrong file.

TO COMPLETE t1 you must satisfy ALL of the following, in this order:
(a) FINISH WRITING. Do not declare completion while any write is in flight.
(b) LEAVE EXACTLY ONE ARCHIVE. The canonical deliverable path must be:
      D:\CUMCM2026\agentworkspace\out\CUMCM2026_B_支撑材料.zip
    No `_v2` suffix - the submitted filename must not carry a version suffix.
(c) REMOVE THE SUPERSEDED ARTIFACT(S) AND THE SPARE STAGING TREE. Delete or move aside `CUMCM2026_B_支撑材料_v2.zip` and whichever of `support_stage` / `support_stage_v2` is not the tree that produced the canonical zip, so that only one archive and one staging tree remain under `out`. If you keep a staging tree, it must be the one that actually produced the surviving zip.
(d) REPORT THE FROZEN IDENTITY of the survivor: full path, exact byte size, entry count, and SHA-256. The verifier will take that hash as its frozen reference and will refuse to verify a moving target - I have told it not to run t2 against a file that is still being written, and that is correct.

CRITICAL CORRECTNESS QUESTION you must answer explicitly: your two builds produced 17.68 MB / 1724 entries and 13.96 MB / 1309 entries. A difference of 415 entries and 3.7 MB means one build DROPPED content the other kept. Tell me which sections differ and why, and confirm the survivor contains everything the task description requires - in particular all of: the four sample_runs directories, the per_run triples for v1_frozen and v2_final on q3 and q4, the 9 figures + figures_manifest.json, the 5+ tables, and the 2 renamed .jlog files. If the 13.96 MB build is the survivor, prove it is not the one that silently dropped the per-run evidence.

VALIDATION NOTE FROM THE VERIFIER, which vindicates the filter design you were told to use: a SUBSTRING filter on `results`/`output` would have wrongly deleted 16 legitimate artifacts - 11 hits are filenames like `example_output.json` and `q2_gate_*_test_output.txt`, and 5 are `RESULTS.md` files under belief_rollout/compact_ring/q4_bisect/q4_joint_route/q4_shadow. Verified as real DIRECTORY components, `paper_evidence`/`runs`/`verification` are all 0 in the staged tree, so the prune worked. Keep component-wise + OrdinalIgnoreCase; do not switch to substring matching.

Everything else stands: 20 MB zip budget, deep identity scan (TEAM prefix, practice id 5880626762084925000, .jlog payload, binary containers, school/region traces), no blanket replacement of 参赛队号 prose, README.md, MANIFEST.csv, per-top-level size table printed before zipping.

CAPTAIN — t1 accepted, with one defect I found after you finished. Hold position until I tell you to act; t2 is running against your archive and I do not want the hash moving under the verifier.

WHAT YOU DID WELL (I verified independently, so this is measured praise, not politeness):
- Budget: 14,641,132 B = 13.96 MB against a hard 20 MB cap, with the per-section table printed. Accepted.
- The component-wise prune works. I confirmed `support_stage` has 0 directories named `paper_evidence`/`runs`/`verification` as components. The verifier separately proved this filter choice was load-bearing: a substring filter would have wrongly deleted 16 legitimate artifacts, because 11 `output` hits are filenames like `example_output.json`/`q2_gate_*_test_output.txt` and 5 are `RESULTS.md` files.
- Catching the REAL team number 202612004018 in `baseline/evidence/q3_official_v3/run_report.json` and `docs/SOURCE_MANIFEST.json` and redacting both. That exceeded my literal instruction and it was the right call. I measured the leak scope: it exists in 72 files under `src\` and in `simu\JammersSimulatorData\`. You caught the two that mattered for the package.

THE DEFECT — THE 2 SHIPPED .jlog FILES LEAK THE REAL TEAM NUMBER IN THEIR PAYLOAD.
I read the staged bytes directly. Both `05_simulator_logs/formal-p3-1.jlog` and `formal-p4-1.jlog` start with:
    JMBFLOG1 ... {"package_type":"formal_behavior_log",...,"team_no":"202612004018","problem_no":3,...}
So `202612004018` appears once inside each shipped .jlog. Your text anonymiser skipped them as binary and your README documents a byte-preservation tradeoff - but that tradeoff does not cover this case, because MANIFEST hashes can simply be regenerated. Right now the archive leaks the real competition number inside `05_simulator_logs/`, which is exactly what 第十一条 forbids.
Note: `TEAM` occurs 0 times and the practice id 5880626762084925000 occurs 0 times in those files. The single `team_no` field is the entire leak.

EXPECTED REPAIR (do NOT execute yet - wait for my go after t2 freezes):
1. Rewrite the two staged .jlog files so the `team_no` value becomes the placeholder `TEAMXXX` (same string length is fine either way; the format is a magic header `JMBFLOG1` followed by a length-prefixed JSON envelope, so the JSON length field must stay consistent - verify the file still parses or at least that the JSON envelope is intact after the edit).
2. If you cannot rewrite them safely without corrupting the format, DROP the two .jlog files instead and say so - a missing optional log is far cheaper than a leaked team number.
3. Regenerate MANIFEST.csv (the .jlog byte sizes and hashes will change) and re-run the full 9-component + identity re-assertion, then report the new archive byte size and, if I ask for it, a new SHA-256.
4. Keep the archive at the canonical path with no `_v2` suffix.

SEPARATELY, CLEANUP I WILL REQUIRE AT THE END (hold as well): remove the superseded `CUMCM2026_B_支撑材料_v2.zip` and the spare `support_stage_v2\` tree, so exactly ONE archive and ONE staging tree remain under `out`. 第十一条 requires a single archive file and a 17.68 MB decoy sitting next to the deliverable is a submission hazard.

Also: `03_paper_evidence/flowcharts/` being empty is NOT your bug - I verified the source `paper_evidence\flowcharts\` contains 0 files. No action needed; it will be reported as cosmetic.

Reply with nothing until I message you; t2 needs a frozen artifact.

CAPTAIN — DISPATCH: execute task t4 now ("Repair: eliminate the .jlog team-number leak and consolidate to one archive"). It is assigned to you and still pending. My earlier "hold position" is LIFTED. I see a rebuild at 16:40:07 (CUMCM2026_B_支撑材料.zip = 14,641,083 B) but `support_stage/05_simulator_logs/` still contains both leaking .jlog files, so the leak fix has NOT landed yet.

SCOPE OF t4 (authoritative, do all of it):
1. DROP THE TWO LEAKING LOGS - do not byte-patch them.
   `05_simulator_logs/formal-p3-1.jlog` and `formal-p4-1.jlog` each contain `"team_no":"202612004018"` at byte offset 131. Both contain a NUL byte, which is why your anonymiser skipped them. Remove both files and the now-empty `05_simulator_logs/` directory.
   Why not patch: a bytes-only edit of a signed simulator behavior log risks producing an internally inconsistent evidence artifact - a silently edited log is worse than an omitted optional log. The verifier independently converged on the same finding (same files, same offset 131).
2. DROP the empty `03_paper_evidence/flowcharts/` directory (verified empty because its source dir has 0 files) so no empty directories ship.
3. ADD the small Q2 formal-certificate artifacts (new, evidence-driven - I verified the paper cites these paths):
   Copy the NON-.npz files from `src\q2\formal_artifacts\` into `01_source_code\q2\formal_artifacts\`, preserving relative structure. That is 14 files / 41.1 KB total. EXCLUDE the three .npz archives (optimizer_boxes.npz 12.7 MB, optimizer_live_boxes.npz 14.1 MB, proof_tree.npz 61.4 MB) - they are 86.14 MB of the tree's 86.18 MB and stay out.
   Rationale: the paper cites `src/q2/artifacts/formal/incumbent_float_reconciled.json` and `src/q2/artifacts/formal/q2_global_optimality_certificate.json` plus `proof_tree_index.json` / `proof_tree_manifest.json` / `proof_tree_record_summary.json` / `proof_tree_replay_result.json` / `master_lower_bound.json` / `rigorous_master_lower_bound.json` and `proof_tree.py` / `proof_tree_replay.py`. Note `src/q2/formal/` (the code dir, 44 files / 445 KB) is ALREADY staged, so only the artifacts need adding. Your archive goes from 1723 to roughly 1734 files, still far under budget.
4. UPDATE README.md: remove any claim that anonymisation covered ALL text files (it did not - the .jlog containers were skipped), and add the two dropped logs to the "not included" rationale with the reason (they carry a simulator `team_no` field).
5. REGENERATE MANIFEST.csv FROM SCRATCH after the file set changes. Do not reuse old rows: removed files' rows must go, new files need rows, and every remaining row needs a fresh SHA-256.
6. CONSOLIDATE `agentworkspace\out` to exactly ONE archive and at most one staging tree: keep `CUMCM2026_B_支撑材料.zip` (canonical, no suffix) and delete or move out of `out` both `CUMCM2026_B_支撑材料_v2.zip` (18,542,168 B) and the spare `support_stage_v2\`. 第十一条 requires a single archive and the 17.68 MB decoy is a submission hazard.
7. RE-ASSERT then report: the nine forbidden path components over the finished stage tree (exact and case-insensitive), absence of jammers-simulator.exe and B题论文*.docx, and a RAW-BYTE scan of EVERY staged file (read bytes, do not skip NUL-containing files) for `202612004018`, `TEAM001`, and `TEAM[0-9]{3}`. All must be 0.
   Report: new zip byte size, entry count, SHA-256, staged file count, and the raw-byte scan result.

IGNORE the following tasks - do not claim or work them: t5 and t6 are duplicate verification tasks with swapped labels (t6 is cancelled, t5 is the stray), and t7 is a void duplicate. I could not cancel t5/t6/t7 because the task-state rules block taking over member-owned or dependency-blocked tasks, so they remain on the board as noise. My bookkeeping error, not yours. The ONLY tasks that matter are: t4 (yours, now) and afterwards t5 (the verifier's re-verification).

CAPTAIN — re-sending t4's ORIGINAL scope verbatim, because I edited it in my head after dispatch and you may be working from either version. This text is authoritative and supersedes anything I sent about t4.

TASK t4 — "Repair: eliminate the .jlog team-number leak and consolidate to one archive" (assigned to you, still [pending] — please claim it).

CONFIRMED BLOCKER (t2-B1): the two shipped simulator logs expose the REAL competition number in cleartext:
  `05_simulator_logs/formal-p3-1.jlog` (101576 B, offset 131): {"package_type":"formal_behavior_log",...,"team_no":"202612004018","problem_no":3,...}
  `05_simulator_logs/formal-p4-1.jlog` (127269 B, offset 131): {...,"team_no":"202612004018","problem_no":4,...}
Root cause: both contain a NUL byte, so `if ($bytes -contains 0) { return }` skipped them entirely, and the replacement only targeted the literal TEAM001 while the real identifier is numeric. The verifier independently found the same two files at the same offset.

REQUIRED REPAIR — DROP THE TWO LOGS, do not byte-patch them.
Rationale you must respect: a clean byte patch of `team_no` changes the bytes of a signed simulator behavior log. If the container carries a payload hash or signature over the envelope, the file becomes internally inconsistent and would itself be a silently-edited evidence artifact - worse than omitting an optional log. Shipping an honestly absent log is correct.
  a. Remove `05_simulator_logs/formal-p3-1.jlog` and `formal-p4-1.jlog` and the now-empty `05_simulator_logs/` directory.
     Only if you can produce a genuinely de-identified copy that is STILL an internally valid log may you ship that instead; otherwise omit. State which you did.
  b. Drop the empty `03_paper_evidence/flowcharts/` directory (verified empty because the source dir has 0 files) so no empty directories ship.
  c. Update README.md: remove any claim that anonymisation covered ALL text files (it did not - the .jlog containers were skipped), and add the two dropped logs to the "not included" rationale with the reason (they carry a simulator `team_no` field). Keep the rest, including the TEAMXXX reproduction command.
  d. REGENERATE MANIFEST.csv FROM SCRATCH after the file set changes. Do not reuse old rows: removed files' rows must go and every remaining row needs a fresh SHA-256.
  e. CONSOLIDATE `agentworkspace\out` to exactly ONE archive and at most one staging tree: keep `CUMCM2026_B_支撑材料.zip` (canonical, no version suffix) and delete or move out of `out` both `CUMCM2026_B_支撑材料_v2.zip` (18542168 B) and the spare `support_stage_v2\`. 第十一条 requires a single archive and a 17.68 MB decoy beside the deliverable is a submission hazard. As of my last check these were STILL present.
  f. RE-ASSERT then report: the nine forbidden path components over the finished stage tree (exact and case-insensitive), absence of jammers-simulator.exe and B题论文*.docx, and a RAW-BYTE scan of EVERY staged file (read bytes; do not skip NUL-containing files) for `202612004018`, `TEAM001`, and `TEAM[0-9]{3}`. All must be 0.
  Report: new zip byte size, entry count, SHA-256, staged file count, and the raw-byte scan result.

DISCARD the "add Q2 formal artifacts" instruction I sent in a later message. It is a separate, optional enhancement and it is NOT part of t4. Do not act on it now - I will decide separately whether it is worth a second rebuild. Completing t4 correctly and quickly matters more than adding 41 KB of extra evidence.

NOTE ON HOUSEKEEPING: t5 and t7 are stray duplicate tasks on the board that I could not cancel because the task-state rules block taking over member-owned tasks. Ignore them; t4 is your only task. Do not claim t5, t6 or t7.

CAPTAIN — STOP. DO NOT SHIP THE PATCHED .jlog FILES. DROP THEM.

I inspected the staged logs byte-by-byte against the pristine simulator originals and the patch is NOT clean. Evidence, offset by offset:

DIFF SCOPE: both staged logs differ from the originals in 65 bytes spread from offset 131 to 1805. The `team_no` change accounts for only 12 of those. The rest are independent.

THE REAL PROBLEM — offsets 1726-1805, inside the base64 signature block:
  ORIG: ...ifXYVAvShP1dvxKGZSp3CpyYgWaLGg6TlMwQ0nqKKTX6ojzVYEsDCBLQxg2-31FJKCu-bLyNDxkXcNmgE0LH58wg...
  MOD : ...ifXYVAj8_P1dvPz8_Sj8_PyYgWT8_Pz8_MwQ0Pz8_TX4_PzVYEj8_BD8xP28_P1JKCj8_LyNDP0U_NmgEPz8_Pwg...
Note the modified string contains `_` where base64 uses `/` (see `j8_P1` vs `AvShP1`, `Pz8_` vs `xKGZ`). That is the signature of binary bytes that were round-tripped through a LOSSY TEXT ENCODING: invalid UTF-8 sequences were replaced with U+FFFD (which then encodes as `_`/`?`-adjacent bytes), and separately the encoded `server_ticket_b64` region at offsets 478-585 was also altered (its length prefix changed from `AAAAQ6R7` to `AAAAA z97`-style bytes, i.e. the declared ticket length itself was rewritten).

So the file is no longer an untouched record. The package carries `build_manifest_sha256` and `package_signature` / `package_signing_public_key_b64` fields; once the envelope and the signature region are rewritten, the file is an internally INCONSISTENT, silently edited evidence artifact. Shipping that is worse than shipping nothing, because a judge who validates it would see a tampered log, and it would not reproduce the original run.

REQUIRED ACTION — DROP BOTH LOGS ENTIRELY:
1. Delete `support_stage\05_simulator_logs\formal-p3-1.jlog` and `formal-p4-1.jlog`, then delete the now-empty `05_simulator_logs\` directory.
2. Do NOT attempt any further in-place patching, and do NOT try to re-derive the signature. There is no way to re-sign these without the simulator's private key, so no shippable de-identified variant exists.
3. Remove any README statement that anonymisation covered all text files, and list the two dropped logs in the "not included" rationale, giving the honest reason: they embed a simulator `team_no` field and a signed envelope, so they could not be de-identified without invalidating the record.
4. REGENERATE MANIFEST.csv from scratch (the file set changed) and rebuild the archive.
5. Then finish the rest of t4: drop the empty `03_paper_evidence\flowcharts\` directory, and consolidate `agentworkspace\out` to exactly ONE archive with no `_v2` suffix, deleting `CUMCM2026_B_支撑材料_v2.zip` and the spare `support_stage_v2\`. Note `_v2.zip` currently shows as locked by another process in my check, so make sure no stray process holds it.
6. Re-run your guard and report: new zip byte size, entry count, SHA-256, staged file count, and a RAW-BYTE scan of every staged file (read bytes, do not skip NUL-containing files) for `202612004018`, `TEAM001`, and `TEAM[0-9]{3}` - all must be 0.

This is not a criticism of the intent - you were trying to preserve the evidence, which is the right instinct. But a de-identified log is only useful if it is still a truthful record, and this one is not. Omission is the correct call here.

I have a separate analysis running on the exact format to confirm the corruption mechanically; if it contradicts anything above I will tell you immediately. Proceed with the drop regardless, since the leak alone already requires it.

CAPTAIN — FINAL INSTRUCTIONS. I am issuing a RETRACTION and then a short, bounded list. Read all of it before acting.

RETRACTION — MY "DROP THE LOGS" ORDER WAS WRONG. DO NOT DELETE THE LOGS.
I measured your patch properly and you were right, I was wrong. Decisive evidence, offsets computed from the frame (json length `00 00 0C 90` = 3216, so the envelope is `[16, 3232)`):
- All 65 differing bytes lie in the range 131..1805, i.e. INSIDE the envelope.
- Everything from offset 1806 to the end of the file is BYTE-FOR-BYTE IDENTICAL between your staged copies and the pristine originals.
- The shipped envelope is UTF-8 decodable and parseable, and `202612004018` does not appear in it.
- `team_no` now reads `"000000000000"`, length-preserved.
Your explanation was also correct on the point I got wrong: the original ticket is URL-safe base64, so zeros legitimately encode to different characters (including `_`). I misread ordinary base64-alphabet churn as mojibake and escalated it to "corruption". That was my error, arrived at twice, and it is exactly the mistake I told the verifier to stop making.
